Gemini said

The URL https://001.100app.dev/ redirects to the BaseMap mobile and desktop hunting GPS application.

GearDrop™ is a recurring promotional feature within the BaseMap app designed to engage outdoor enthusiasts by offering them a chance to win premium hunting and outdoor gear.  
PR Newswire

What is GearDrop?

GearDrop functions as a gamified loyalty or engagement program within the BaseMap ecosystem. It is frequently highlighted as one of the app's interactive community features, alongside its core mapping and navigation tools.  
UpdateStar

How it works: Users typically participate in the challenge directly through the BaseMap platform for a chance to win featured products from industry partners.  
basemap-hunting-gps-maps.updatestar.com

Purpose: It serves to incentivize app usage and reward the community, often featuring partnerships with well-known outdoor brands and personalities, such as the Bone Collector team.  
PR Newswire

What BaseMap Offers Outdoor Enthusiasts

Since the link directs you to BaseMap, users gain access to a comprehensive suite of digital scouting and navigation tools tailored for hunters, hikers, and anglers:  
UpdateStar

Advanced Mapping: Access to nationwide public and private land ownership data, parcel boundaries, and owner names (often restricted to Pro subscribers).  
UpdateStar

Offline Navigation: The ability to download high-resolution satellite imagery and topographic maps for use in areas without cellular service.  
UpdateStar

Planning Tools: Features like HuntWind™ (wind direction and scent drift forecasting), 3D terrain visualization, and "SmartMarkers" for logging trail cameras, stand locations, or animal sightings.  
PR Newswire

Tracking & Logging: Real-time GPS tracking and an "Outdoor Journal" to log harvest data, weather conditions, and trip details.  
UpdateStar

Note: Several outdoor brands use the term "Gear Drop" (or "GearDrop") for their own content. For example, Mossy Oak hosts a "Gear Drop" video series where they review and showcase the latest hunting products. However, in the context of the specific URL provided, it refers to the giveaway feature within the BaseMap hunting app.
